import ctypes
import os
from ctypes import c_int, c_double, POINTER, byref

# Define the result structure
class gsl_sf_result(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('val', c_double), ('err', c_double)]

# Load the libraries
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# int gsl_sf_bessel_Kn_e(const int n, const double x, gsl_sf_result * result)
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Kn_e.argtypes = [c_int, c_double, POINTER(gsl_sf_result)]
gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Kn_e.restype = c_int

def bessel_Kn(n, x):
    result = gsl_sf_result()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_Kn_e(n, x, byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError(f"Error in computation: status code {status}")
    return result.val
